verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM runner powered by llama.cpp, so diagnosing GPU-acceleration failures and CPU fallback is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions GPU detection, fallback behavior, logs, or diagnostic output. The only nearby material is a general statement that the API server is "powered by llama.cpp", which says nothing about diagnosing acceleration failures.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
